title: Arcadia Cobblemon Modpack
description:
Arcadia is a handcrafted expansion modpack for Cobblemon, built to deliver the ultimate Pokémon adventures in Minecraft.

Enter the world of Arcadia, where dreams and adventures await — let’s go!

# Arcadia — A Cobblemon Server & Modpack **An expansion pack for Cobblemon, handcrafted for the ultimate Pokémon adventures in Minecraft.** --- --- At the heart of Arcadia is **Cobblemon**, Arcadia is an expansion of Cobblemon handcrafted for the ultimate Pokémon experience with carefully selected content, mechanics, and improvements that bring the world to life. Created for the **Arcadia Server**, Arcadia is a living Pokémon world where Trainers can explore, build, battle, and create their own stories alongside a community of players. Discover breathtaking landscapes, rare Pokémon, powerful opponents, and endless possibilities. Whether you are building a cozy home, farming, crafting, chasing legendary encounters, or traveling with your team, your adventure is yours to experience. With enhanced world generation, immersive visuals, shaders, resource packs, and performance-focused optimization, Arcadia delivers a beautiful and atmospheric Pokémon experience while keeping gameplay smooth and enjoyable. Embark on the ultimate Pokémon adventures, or slow down and enjoy the slice-of-life moments in a living, evolving survival world. --- # 📖 Explore Arcadia - ⚔️ The Ultimate Cobblemon Expansion - 🌟 Complete Pokémon Battle Gimmicks - 🐉 Expand Your Pokédex - 🌟 Legendary Raids & Endgame Challenges - 🔴 Create Your Own Poké Balls - 🧬 Raise & Train Your Team - 🏰 Create Your Own Challenges - 🏡 Live the Life of a Pokémon Trainer - ✈️ Soar the Skies - 🌎 A Living World - ✨ Polished Adventure Experience - 📦 Included Content Mods - 🙏 Credits - 💬 Join the Arcadia Community --- # Features ## ⚔️ The Ultimate Cobblemon Expansion Cobblemon is the foundation of Arcadia, bringing Pokémon into Minecraft through an immersive open-world adventure. Arcadia expands upon that experience with new Pokémon, battle mechanics, progression systems, exploration, and ways to live as a Trainer. --- ## 🌟 Complete Pokémon Battle Gimmicks With **Cobblemon: Mega Showdown**, Arcadia brings the biggest Pokémon battle mechanics into Minecraft. Experience: - **Mega Evolution** — unleash powerful Mega Forms - **Z-Moves** — use devastating signature attacks - **Dynamax & Gigantamax** — transform Pokémon into massive powerhouses - **Terastallization** — change your Pokémon's type and battle strategy Build your team, master different battle styles, and experience Pokémon battles like never before. --- ## 🐉 Expand Your Pokédex Discover a larger Pokémon world through **AllTheMons x Mega Showdown**. This expansion adds: - Legendary Pokémon - Pokémon unavailable in base Cobblemon - New encounters and team-building possibilities Explore further, discover rare Pokémon, and create the perfect team for your adventure. --- ## 🌟 Legendary Raids & Endgame Challenges Take on powerful encounters through: - **Myths and Legends** - **Cobblemon Raid Dens** - **Myths and Legends Raid Dens integration** Collect special items, activate Legendary Pokémon Raids, and challenge powerful opponents worthy of a true Pokémon Champion. --- ## 🔴 Create Your Own Poké Balls With **Cobblemon Modular Poké Balls**, catching Pokémon becomes part of your personal Trainer identity. Customize your Poké Balls by changing: - Capsule tops - Capsule bottoms - Center buttons - Colors and combinations Discover new colored Apricorns and craft multiple tiers of Poké Balls to match your style. --- ## 🧬 Raise & Train Your Team Your Pokémon journey is about more than catching. Arcadia expands progression with: - **Cobblemon Unchained** — enhanced Pokémon hunting progression - **Cobblemon Capture XP** — rewards catching and exploration - **Cobblemon PlayerXP** — additional training progression - **Cobbreeding** — raise new Pokémon through breeding - **Cobblemon Home** — personal Pokémon storage for singleplayer worlds Train your partners, discover rare Pokémon, and create a team that grows alongside your adventure. --- ## 🏰 Create Your Own Challenges With **Cobblemon Secret Base Trainer**, you can create your own battles and challenges. Build your own gyms, create custom Trainer encounters, and challenge others with your strongest teams. --- ## 🏡 Live the Life of a Pokémon Trainer Not every adventure is about battling. Build your home, farm, cook, and create a cozy place for yourself and your Pokémon. Featuring: - Farmer's Delight - Rustic Delight - Crate Delight - Botany Pots - Botany Trees Create a peaceful home between adventures and enjoy the everyday life of a Trainer. --- ## ✈️ Soar the Skies With **Create & Create Aeronautics** and other Create add-ons, soar the skies, build contraptions, create! Build contraptions including: - Airships - Planes - Balloons - Automated machines - Custom transportation systems Travel farther, build bigger, and create! --- ## 🌎 A Living World Explore a world redesigned for adventure with: - Nature's Spirit - William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld - BiomeBloom - Biome Replacer - Ecliptic Seasons Discover new landscapes, changing environments, and a world that feels alive throughout your journey. --- ## ✨ Polished Adventure Experience Arcadia includes carefully selected improvements that enhance immersion without taking away from Cobblemon. Enjoy: - Enhanced visuals and shader support - Better exploration tools - Improved building options - Storage improvements - Multiplayer quality-of-life features - Performance optimizations Every addition exists to make the Pokémon x Minecraft experience feel complete. --- # 📦 Included Content Mods
